name: DEF CON Media
description: The DEF CON media server: recorded talks from every DEF CON conference with video, one channel per conference, with search and captions where available.
author: mephisto

1: One channel per conference, talks listed from each conference's video folder
Home feed (newest conference first) and search, across all conferences or within one
Playback on Grayjay Desktop through a generated DASH stream built from the original MP4 (works around the server's cross-origin policy)
Subtitles fetched by the plugin and converted to WebVTT
Real durations and a transcript excerpt from the server's auto-generated captions
